releases.name: v0.2.2 — native execution and EOF-safe completion
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Reduce executor overhead with bounded adapter-output parsing and a lightweight POSIX capture engine. OpenCode integration remains required; the Bun compatibility executor remains available.
- Wait for inherited stdout and stderr writers to reach EOF before consuming native results.
- Preserve interruption completion across Bash, Dash and Ash without ignoring SIGPIPE in executed CLIs.
- Update the package and pinned installation instructions to `0.2.2`. Dependency versions are unchanged.

## Compatibility

This release retains the documented OpenCode V2 beta contract and matching `@opencode-ai/cli@0.0.0-beta-17823` runtime (`opencode2`). Set `OPENCODE_HERDR_RUNNER=bun` for the compatibility executor and per-event pane progress.

Native execution uses private temporary captures; `keepJobs` can retain sensitive raw CLI output. Historical memory measurements predate the EOF-relay correction and were not repeated for this release. No new total-OpenCode or real-provider memory-saving claim is made.

Real-provider generation, live Herdr/physical keyboard interaction and Windows runtime remain unverified.

## Verification

- Release-version CI: 192 tests passed, zero failures; typecheck passed.
- Independent package verification: runtime payloads and executable modes match the tested merged implementation; dependencies and lockfile are unchanged.

releases.name: v0.2.1 — model configuration menu
releases.body:
## Model configuration menu

- Open `/herdr-model`, `/herdr-routing`, or **Alt+H** from the existing TUI companion.
- Assign enabled, tool-capable models from Herdr or other providers, including reasoning variants and provider defaults.
- Filter Herdr-assigned agents, clear an assignment, or cancel without saving.
- Preserve unrelated settings and schema-1 Herdr routing; roll back configuration if routing persistence fails.

This release includes only the portable menu, its regression tests/docs, and version pins. Provider implementation, dependency pins, and Gentle AI launchers are unchanged. Private configurations and memory files are not included.

## Verification

- 129 tests passed, 501 assertions; TypeScript and package checks passed.
- Native beta smoke passed with fake adapters, without model inference.
- The installed tarball automatically loaded its TUI companion; keyboard input opened the agent/provider selectors and cancellation preserved data.
- Attached archive SHA256: `c9352e44902e313b871b9660972dd8ec5ea3a52a7b99e48dae6f981c9e5e1451`.

## Compatibility

The server integration still targets OpenCode V2 beta `@opencode-ai/cli@0.0.0-beta-17823` (`opencode2`). This release does not migrate the provider to the stable SDK. The menu edits global JSON configuration; it does not rewrite JSONC. Real provider inference and the default runtime downloader remain outside the verified scope.

## Changes
- Native OpenCode V2 provider/model registration and session-bound local TUI commands and feedback.
- Preserve explicit routing variant clearing and keep command execution paired with the selected session's workspace across asynchronous operations.
- Fix npm-installed handover launcher symlink resolution.
- Update installation guidance and security support for 0.2.x, retaining 0.1.x support.

## Verification
Integrated main passed frozen installation, typecheck, 120 tests (425 expectations), lifecycle smoke and a supplied beta17823 catalog smoke. The 37-file package matched the verified source and installed launcher checks passed. Dependency versions are unchanged.

## Compatibility
This stable plugin release targets `@opencode-ai/cli@0.0.0-beta-17823` (`opencode2`). Compatibility is scoped to that verified OpenCode V2 beta, not every future V2 build. Real-provider generation, physical keyboard interaction, the default runtime downloader and remote-workspace ownership remain unverified. Existing transitive Socket alerts are not claimed remediated.

releases.name: v0.1.2 — agent lifecycle and command toasts
releases.body:
- Delegated panes report working/idle and release Herdr authority across success, failure, timeout, and cancellation.
- Hardened launch rollback, first-terminal race handling, and `keepPanes` cleanup.
- Removed automatic session-created Herdr presence toast; command toasts now appear only when actual Herdr commands run.
